Custom TIE holds one pilot, has printed Nav Computer and grants immunity to attrition<4 when Vader pilots it. Ship immunity follows Vader identity even if his text is canceled; matching stat bonuses follow Vader text even if ship text is canceled.

Native-only integration also verifies real free docking bay landing, pilot capacity, uniqueness, OTSD106_10 distinction, battle participation and strict immunity threshold, excluded pilot and missing pilot branches.
